content.subtitle: Reverse proxy and load balancing with HAProxy
content.gettingStartedBody: VyOS requires a backend and a service to be configured at the same time. Use Quick Setup to create both in one step.
content.incompleteNoBackends: You have services but no backends. VyOS will reject commits until at least one backend is added.
content.incompleteNoServices: You have backends but no services. VyOS will reject commits until at least one service is added.
content.useQuickSetupHint: Use Quick Setup to create a backend and service together (required by VyOS).
content.noBackendsHint: Backends define server pools for load balancing.
content.noServicesHint: Services are the frontends that accept incoming traffic.
content.deleteLastBackendWarning: Warning: this is your last backend. VyOS will reject any subsequent changes until you add a new backend alongside the existing service.
content.deleteBackendDescription: This will remove the backend and all its server and rule configurations. This action cannot be undone.
content.deleteLastServiceWarning: Warning: this is your last service. VyOS will reject any subsequent changes until you add a new service alongside the existing backend.
content.deleteServiceDescription: This will remove the service and all its routing rules. This action cannot be undone.

backendDetail.noRulesHint: All requests are forwarded according to the balance algorithm. Add rules to route specific traffic to individual servers.

serviceDetail.noRulesHint: All traffic is load-balanced across the configured backends. Add rules to route by domain, URL path, or SSL condition.
